goal: For every essay question currently in MCNS-2, find the best-matching iNerd essay by text similarity. If matched with high confidence, replace modelAnswer. If low confidence or no match, flag for book-OCR fallback.
summary: Phase 2 complete. Cross-matched all 780 bank essays against 1044 iNerd essays using Jaccard word-overlap similarity. Result: 448 essays updated with iNerd curriculum-aligned answers (score >= 0.40), 332 essays flagged as needs-book-fallback. All 780 original essays tracked in report. Deliverables: updated MCNS-2.json, .kimchi/docs/essay-overhaul-report.json, scripts/cross-match-essays.py.
